title: Supply, Installation & Commissioning of High-Pressure Centrifugal Pumps for CPCL Manali Refinery

criteria.title: GST & Legal Identity
criteria.description: Valid GSTIN registration and PAN card parity

criteria.title: Average Annual Turnover
criteria.description: Minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 13.5 Crores (30% of estimated value) in last 3 FYs

criteria.title: Net Worth Solvency
criteria.description: Positive net worth as per audited balance sheet of immediately preceding FY

criteria.title: Make in India (PPP-MII) Local Content
criteria.description: Class-I local supplier declaration with >= 50% local value addition

criteria.title: Land Border Sharing Rule 144(xi)
criteria.description: Mandatory compliance certificate regarding beneficial ownership from countries sharing land border

criteria.title: OEM Manufacturer Authorization
criteria.description: Tender-specific authorization letter from OEM pump manufacturer

criteria.title: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)
criteria.description: EMD submission of Rs. 9,00,000 or valid MSE Udyam exemption certificate
